comments.text: Great video. This is fairly atypical. Blur and Oasis were chart rivals and the 2 main players in the mid-90s Britpop scene. They used to slag each other off in interviews, especially Oasis - Noel Gallagher always with a few choice words. The rivalry peaked when they both had new singles out at the same time. Both were booked on the UK's best known music TV show, Top of the Pops. Blur got to No.1. On TOTPs, when Blur played their No.1 hit, Blur's bassist, Alex James, ironically wore an Oasis t-shirt.
